coordinate_system: 1024x576, xywh, integer half-open bounds; native left/top floor and right/bottom ceil by actual 1920/1024 scale
selection_order: Saved after original RGB-only localization and old localization-record comparison, before any new ROI disparity/CoC/output statistics.
representative_frame_rule: B20/B34 0/12/24; includes prior B20 frame24 and B34 frame12. Train 0/6/12 follows user early-frame observation, exact user frame unknown.

historical_comparison.B20: frame24 adult shoe boxes and child-shoes box exactly reuse old B20 input diagnosis; earlier frames independently located on RGB
historical_comparison.B34: frame12 bell_core, bell_context and neck_comparison exactly reuse old B34 input diagnosis; frames0/24 independently located on RGB
historical_comparison.train: no previous numeric ROI; red last carriage opposite blue locomotive is a candidate requiring confirmation

limits: Controls are adjacent comparisons only, never newly designated correction references.
Rectangles may mix shoe/bell/leg/background; full rectangle and target-ID intersection reported separately, neither is object-depth truth.
RGB-only anatomical localization is provisional, user confirms whether boxes match described problem.
Train is DOF-change evidence, not confirmed depth error.
No neural inference, no new condition intervention, no tau/mask changes.

rows.localization_method: assistant manual input-RGB localization; separately localized each representative frame; no tracking or output-driven selection
